issues.detail: Grokbot placed 'Coal Mining / Land Stability Risk Assessment' under Householder, Listed building consent, Advertisement consent, Lawful development cert, Change of use - prior approval, Works to trees and Hazardous substances. Its own trigger excerpt is the Coal Mining Risk Assessment EXEMPTIONS table, which answers 'No' (CMRA not required) for those application types. The requirement was inverted.
issues.evidence: Trigger excerpt: 'Coal Mining Risk Assessments Exemptions list Part A - Type of Application ... Is a CMRA required? (Yes / No) No Householder Development ... Advertisement Consent No Lawful Development Certificates No Prior Notification (any type) No ...'

issues.detail: Outline and Reserved matters are recorded as '(none) - national requirements only', but Grokbot's own tab_items show the document contains dedicated 'OUTLINE PLANNING APPLICATIONS CHECKLIST' and 'RESERVED MATTERS APPLICATIONS CHECKLIST' pages, which set what each type must include. Demolition in a conservation area is also '(none)', even though heritage and photograph requirements would apply.
issues.evidence: tab_items: '77 OUTLINE PLANNING APPLICATIONS (WITH ALL MATTERS RESERVED) CHECKLIST', '83 RESERVED MATTERS APPLICATIONS CHECKLIST'

issues.detail: About 30 requirements are put under Full planning with an 'INFERRED' note, although the source has per-application-type checklists (householder, outline, reserved matters, etc.) that could have been used. For example, Heritage Statement, Tree Survey/AIA and Ecology also apply to householder and listed building applications, and 'Schedule of works' is a barn/rural conversion item rather than a general Full planning one.
issues.evidence: Notes: 'INFERRED: application type not named in extracted text of a general local list; placed under Full planning'

issues.detail: All 17 tab_items are drawing conventions, process text or signposting, not local requirements. Examples: 'All plans should have a date of issue and separate drawing number', 'In exceptional circumstances, plans of other standard metric scales may also be required', 'Advice regarding procedures for validation disputes may be found at:', 'The number of copies required ... should be agreed', and links to the drainage guidance PDF. Two rows are just headers for the outline and reserved matters checklists. The 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' app_type row is advisory text, not a validation requirement.
issues.evidence: tab_items sections 'Drawing / document standards' and 'Submission rules'; 'It is advised that early pre-application discussions are entered into...'

issues.detail: Several trigger excerpts are empty, cut off, or describe content rather than when the item applies. Flood Risk Assessment: 'When is this required? .' (no trigger). Employment/Economic Statement: 'by an Economic Statement.'. Ventilation/Extraction: 'flues or extraction systems.'. Structural Survey: 'Green Belt, a structural survey will be required.' (condition cut off). Levels: 'to existing ground levels or where ground levels outside the 17 extension would be modified' (page number embedded). Travel Plan: 'should include details of targets and arrangements for monitoring' (content, not trigger). Open space: 'facilities an open space assessment will be required.' (threshold lost).

Some items are duplicated. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' and 'Foul Sewage / Utilities Statement' use the same foul-drainage/SuDS proforma text. 'Employment / Economic Statement' and 'Retail / Town Centre Impact Assessment' both come from the single Economic Statement requirement. The outline and reserved matters checklist header text appears twice in tab_items, once from each PDF version.
issues.evidence: Both rows: 'For all Major Development (10 or more dwellings ...) an additional SuDs proforma is required'; 'will need to be accompanied by an Economic Statement'

summary: Grokbot cites media/545649 (July 2020 update), but the council's validation page now links media/548069 'Validation Criteria & Checklist' as the latest criteria (undated). Both PDFs are blocked to fetch, so the contents were not verified. Grokbot's own extract still shows clear errors: the Coal Mining exemptions table was turned into a requirement for 7 application types, outline and reserved matters checklists were ignored, tab_items are all boilerplate, and several triggers are empty or truncated.
